speaker: growth-coach
content: Project-upsilon today. system-architect — fresh ground, walk us through.

speaker: system-architect
content: Project-upsilon is the mobile companion app. Twelve-week plan, kicked off 2026-01-19. Engineering lead is agent-gamma. They have one senior plus a designer from design-firm-nu on a four-day-a-week contract.

speaker: agent-alpha
content: Why a mobile companion now? What's the strategic frame?

speaker: growth-coach
content: exec-theta wants to reduce the 'first response time' for partner enquiries. Today partners go through a web form that gets triaged by a human in 4-8 hours. The mobile app lets partner-ops respond from anywhere in <15 minutes.

speaker: system-architect
content: First-release scope is read-only — partners list, partner detail, basic notifications. Edit capability ships in v2. That keeps the v1 attack surface narrow and the schedule predictable.

speaker: system-architect
content: iOS-first because that's where 80% of the partner-ops team's personal devices are. Android follows in the v2 release.

speaker: system-architect
content: App store review timing is the biggest unknown. We've allowed two weeks for first-submission review but Apple has been variable lately. If review pushes the launch we'd ship the TestFlight build to partner-ops directly while waiting.

speaker: agent-alpha
content: Sensible. What's the launch target date?

speaker: system-architect
content: Target launch is 2026-04-13. That's twelve weeks from kickoff. Project-upsilon status: green, on plan.
